items.title: Calculating Plausible Population Values

  1. [MATH: r > 13{,}000]

  2. [MATH: 10{,}080 < r < 12{,}480]

  3. [MATH: 9{,}500 < r < 9{,}900]

  4. [MATH: r < 10{,}000]
